svg.text: stolen portal session alone cannot read a secret.

svg.text: Verify: manifest hashes match; every gitleaks hit has a triage result and every real secret a rotation record; no CRITICAL Trivy row without an accepted-risk ID. Controls: IA-5(7), RA-5, SA-15, SR-3, SC-12.
